title: MBA: Multimodal Benchmark and Agents for Real-World Business Ideation
abstract: arXiv:2608.11616v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic systems powered by large language models (LLMs) have opened new opportunities for business ideation. Yet existing approaches remain confined to a text-only paradigm, despite the inherently multimodal nature of real-world contexts. We thus introduce MBA-Bench, the first multimodal benchmark for training and evaluating business ideation agents, comprising 30K samples across six domains, each domain characterized by distinct visual cues not fully conveyed by text alone. Concretely, we automatically caption images and employ GPT-4o to generate five reference ideas for each of three business questions through retrieval query generation, market evidence retrieval, and evidence-augmented synthesis. Following prior work, we evaluate agents across six business-oriented criteria using MLLM-as-a-Judge. translated_title: MBA：面向现实商业构思的多模态基准与智能体
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11616v1 公告类型：新 摘要：由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体系统为商业构思开辟了新机遇。然而，现有方法仍局限于纯文本范式，尽管现实世界情境本质上具有多模态特性。为此，我们引入了MBA-Bench，这是首个用于训练和评估商业构思智能体的多模态基准，包含六个领域的30K个样本，每个领域具有文本无法完全传达的独特视觉线索。具体而言，我们自动为图像生成标题，并通过检索查询生成、市场证据检索和证据增强综合，使用GPT-4o为每个商业问题生成五个参考想法。遵循先前工作，我们使用MLLM-as-a-Judge在六个商业导向标准上评估智能体。为了考虑标准隐藏或公开的情况，我们分别提出MBA-b（盲）和MBA-k（已知）。我们对两者进行训练。
tldr: 本文提出了首个多模态商业构思基准MBA-Bench，包含30K个跨领域样本，并通过GPT-4o生成参考想法及MLLM评判机制，突破了现有纯文本商业智能体的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MBA-Bench, the first multimodal benchmark for business ideation with 30K cross-domain samples, using GPT-4o-generated references and MLLM-as-a-Judge, overcoming the text-only limitation of existing agents.
